title: Make Beads Viewer decision-aware and canonical-actionable
description:
The static Viewer and raw robot planning do not understand the custom decision status: owner questions receive autonomous start wording, actionable counts differ from br ready, and status totals overlap. Make the checked export and operational view reflect the repository-owned decision workflow.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run the workflow described above and observe the mismatch.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Decision issues have a distinct visible status and owner queue; no decision receives autonomous claim or quick-win wording; the actionable count and identifiers equal br ready; active and blocked counts are disjoint and total correctly; graph, list, and detail remain visible; an automated export assertion prevents regression even if upstream bv still treats unknown statuses as open.

title: Enforce the cooperative owner-decision lifecycle and authoritative agent plan
description:
Repair the repository-owned Beads workflow guard. Beads Rust does not authenticate the project owner, so this is cooperative policy: active owner decisions must remain in the non-ready decision status, closed decisions retain provenance, reopening restores the decision workflow, normal work cannot silently enter it, and autonomous planning must use the checked repository wrapper rather than raw Viewer recommendations.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run the workflow described above and observe the mismatch.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A transition-matrix fixture proves active decision labels and status agree, legitimate close passes and unblocks, reopen is restored to decision before autonomous use, claim or arbitrary status drift is detected, and ordinary work cannot carry decision status without both labels. The validator runs in repository-owned pre-commit and CI gates. br ready, scheduler, and .beads/agent-plan.sh expose no owner decision and agree on actionable IDs. Documentation states that actor metadata is not authentication and raw bv robot planning is advisory.

comments.text: Reopened: Round-four transition tests found that close, reopen, claim, and raw Viewer planning were not safely covered.

title: Converge Omnirepo on its Constitution
description:
## Goal

Bring the current 0.8.x implementation into complete alignment with the ratified Omnirepo Constitution and routed Canon architecture.

## Current state

The quality baseline passes, but the product still exposes general repository creation, tag cloning, arbitrary shell execution, and ad hoc synchronization authority. It lacks canonical machine/source/repository configuration, source materialization, exact partials, contained atomic file transactions, verified scoped Git delivery, crash-recoverable durable accounting, bounded repair, and lawful release handling.

## Program rule

Decision-needed children are owner blockers and may not be guessed. Implementation preserves exact one-way authority, visible whole/section edges, independent outcomes, complete durable accounting, bounded sync-induced repair, and the constitutional limits. Actionable migration guidance is mandatory for breaking releases; an automated migrator is implemented only under its explicit decision.

## Success Criteria

See structured acceptance criteria; every mandatory child must close before the epic is eligible.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed; the final implementation passes the Constitution gate across the full product surface; Cargo quality, MSRV, coverage, and pre-commit gates pass; public docs describe only the constitutional product.
notes: Decision-needed and human-input children are policy blockers for the project owner. Agents may audit or prepare questions but must not implement or close them by guessing. Work only from .beads/agent-plan.sh or br ready; raw Beads Viewer robot planning is advisory. Suggested owner sequence: (1) package/API, platform, encoding, delimiter and agent trust boundaries; (2) canonical config, sources, item identity, commands, run records and release identity; (3) source declarations, schema evolution, overlap/recovery, Git, residue, verification and evidence; (4) repair, migration and CLI outcomes; (5) setup authoring. Standalone optional-growth, hardening and repository-workflow beads remain visible but are not mandatory epic completion evidence.

title: Remove the arbitrary multi-repository run surface
description:
Boundary 1 forbids a general repository orchestrator. The public run command and src/run/runners.rs accept arbitrary shell strings and execute sh -c across repositories. Remove only this public and general runner surface, its tests, docs, verbose/global logging coupled to it, and any equivalent arbitrary fleet command. The repository-declared verifier is owned separately and must not be implemented here.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: omnirepo help no longer advertises run; clap rejects it; no production API accepts an arbitrary user-supplied fleet command; general runner, obsolete tests, docs, and misleading logger help are removed; no replacement general command is introduced; Canon quality gates pass.

title: Fan out initial repository passes and collect initial fleet results
description:
Schedule the one-repository initial-pass service across the machine-declared fleet under bounded parallelism and durable repository leases. Completion order is unspecified; each fleet member receives exactly one initial-pass result for later finalization or separately invoked repair.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Valid repositories proceed independently despite bounded peer failure, hang, or cancellation; not-started and cancelled members receive typed initial results; admission and completion order never alter authority, precedence, or accounting; no peer rollback occurs; the service invokes no repair agent and does not call an initial result final.

title: Finalize complete run summaries and quiet terminal projections
description:
Consume the durable journal and terminal repository outcomes, then finalize the complete run summary when persistence succeeds and render the CLI's concise projection. No worker, adapter, logger, progress bar, or table writes directly to stdout or stderr; all producers emit typed events and one renderer applies TTY, non-TTY and evidence policy.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A successfully persisted run finalizes one summary with one terminal entry per selected repository. If creation or finalization fails, output follows the owner record-unavailable contract, names the last safely durable identity when available, and never prints a false record pointer or claims success. Quiet success, failure, cancellation, redirected output, and TTY behavior contain no interleaving, progress artifacts, raw evidence, or ANSI/control injection.

title: Run bounded post-pass repair and fold final outcomes
description:
After the complete initial fleet pass, consume durable eligibility reservations and individual confined attempt results. Apply configured agent priority, fallback, repair limits, exhaustion, interruption, and restart semantics, then fold exactly one terminal outcome per repository without turning repair into the initial sync phase.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Only reserved current-run eligible failures enter repair; attempts and fallback never exceed the durable budget; crashes, incomplete attempts, timeouts, adapter failure and exhaustion follow owner policy without double consumption; peers remain independent; every attempted or skipped failure is accounted; final outcomes incorporate initial and repair evidence and no protected or unrelated delta survives contrary to residue policy.

title: Implement explicitly delegated breaking migration operation
description:
Conditional growth only if the owner explicitly selects automated migration. Otherwise close this bead as owner-declined without creating a CLI. A selected separately invoked migrator validates declared version applicability and uses the confined agent and lifecycle infrastructure without repair-causation eligibility. Actionable manual migration guidance remains mandatory regardless.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: No install, config load or sync implicitly migrates; when automation is selected, every predecessor selected by the release and migration decisions has a provenance-checked hermetic fixture and exact applicability check; skipped, current, repeat, downgrade, future, unsupported, ambiguous, interrupted and resumed cases follow policy; when declined, no migration command or hidden path exists; machine fleet, sources, precedence and unrelated maintenance remain protected.

title: Align CLI, package metadata, and docs with constitutional synchronization
description:
After the machine-driven CLI and mandatory breaking-change decision land, align help, README, CHANGELOG, package metadata and contents, selected public Rust surface, examples, setup, installation, and migration guidance with authoritative file and section synchronization. Inventory every user-visible compatibility break since the last actually published supported baseline.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Public wording and package contents describe only constitutional synchronization; legacy commands, ad hoc source authority, .omni.yaml and generic-manager claims are gone; clean-HOME setup reaches first inferred sync; help documents exit, streams, cancellation and record-unavailable behavior; binary install/update is distinct from any optional separately invoked destination migration; each supported predecessor has actionable guidance; dependency, feature, cargo package --list, packaged help/doctest, changelog and install audits pass.

title: Remove the legacy tag-based clone workflow
description:
Remove the public legacy clone --tags workflow and central .omni.yaml generation. This bead is pure removal of tag-driven destination fleet orchestration, its tests, and docs. It does not retain, redesign, or promise source materialization; the separate source policy and catalog beads own any future internal acquisition.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Public help and APIs expose no tag-driven clone; tag matching cannot determine fleet membership or applicability; .omni.yaml is not generated; legacy implementation, tests, and docs are removed without introducing replacement cloning behavior; Canon quality gates pass.

title: Define source-repository materialization policy
description:
Owner decision required for materializing machine-declared authoritative source repositories. Select supported source-reference classes, revision selection, refresh and cache placement, dirty-source handling, offline and unavailable-priority-source behavior, timeout, retry, cleanup and redaction. For each selected remote class only, decide authentication, ambient Git configuration and URL rewriting, schemes, redirects, proxy, submodules, LFS, filters and cross-origin credential handling.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines one lifecycle for each source class, including freshness, revision, cache, concurrency, interrupted staging, offline and failure fan-out; ambient and repository Git config/env, credential and remote helpers, sshCommand, hooksPath, filters, submodule/LFS helpers, URL rewrites, alternates and executable protocol helpers are explicitly governed; no unavailable higher source is silently dropped; irrelevant remote policy is not required for local-only classes.

title: Define fleet concurrency control semantics
description:
Define the implementation-level concurrency controls the owner already authorized as configurable. Produce schema inputs, defaults, valid ranges, zero behavior, and per-run versus nested child scheduling semantics for the canonical machine configuration, public CLI conventions, and bounded scheduler. This work may not invent a third authority tier or change machine versus repository ownership.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The design exposes bounded repository and nested child-work concurrency with documented conservative defaults and ranges; placement and override behavior conform to the decided canonical config and CLI contracts; repository policy gains no fleet, source or priority authority; .3 parses it and .47 enforces it without ambient Rayon defaults; deterministic boundary tests are specified.

title: Define configuration serialization, discovery, and conflict policy
description:
Owner decision required for canonical machine, repository, and source-declaration serialization. Select supported <extension> variants at the constitutionally fixed stems <HOME>/.omnirepo/config.<extension> and destination-root .omnirepo.<extension>, plus source-declaration placement under authoritative sources; define exact-root discovery, HOME-unavailable behavior, non-file and unreadable candidates, multi-format conflicts, unknown fields, destination references, aliases, and legacy .omni.yaml handling.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects formats at fixed authority locations, exact discovery and conflict behavior, destination reference and existence behavior, absent versus present-invalid handling, unknown-field policy, aliases and legacy migration error behavior; no arbitrary CLI config substitutes machine authority; configuration-authority Canon records the contract.

title: Define managed-item identity, precedence, and collision semantics
description:
Owner decision required for stable whole-file and section identity and source overlap. Define duplicate declaration keys, path and section identity, earlier-versus-later ordered source winner, collisions among whole files and multiple sections in one destination file, reserved authority targets, and whether repository .omnirepo.<extension> may ever be managed without destroying its independent policy authority. Applicability selection is owned separately.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines stable identities, duplicate and alias handling, overlap winner, grouping and collision rejection for all whole/section combinations, and protected authority targets; configuration-authority and managed-content Canon record the contract; catalogs and plans can resolve conflicts before mutation.

title: Retire general-purpose repository creation
description:
## Constitutional finding

Growth Directive 5 says to grow through file and section synchronization, "not by expanding into general repository orchestration." Boundary 1 limits Omnirepo to synchronization plus commit, push, checks, and sync-induced repair.

## Current evidence

src/bin/main.rs exposes new; src/new/project_creation.rs creates arbitrary repositories, copies tag-selected templates, and runs git init. README.md presents repository creation as a core product feature.

## Scope

Remove the general new command and its production module, tests, and documentation. Any future onboarding must be a synchronization-specific setup path driven by the constitutional configuration and inference model, not a generic project generator.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.
acceptance_criteria: The public CLI has no general new command; project creation/template-generation code and obsolete tests are removed; README and package wording no longer claim general project generation; installation-to-first-sync onboarding remains covered by the configuration/inference beads; all Canon quality gates pass.

title: Define managed-text encoding and exactness contract
description:
Owner decision required because the current String and HTTP text paths may reject invalid UTF-8 or alter BOM and replacement characters while Canon requires faithful exact text. Select whether the authoritative unit is bytes or a named text encoding, supported encodings, BOM handling, invalid-sequence behavior, and the comparison unit.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines the supported representation and exact comparison semantics, including Unicode, BOM, invalid sequences, and newline preservation; managed-content Canon records the rule; catalog, whole-file, partial-section, and documentation beads adopt it consistently.

title: Define managed-section delimiter grammar and format coverage
description: Owner decision required before literal public delimiters can be implemented. Select marker grammar and section identity, initial extension-to-comment-syntax registry, extension matching, unknown or extensionless behavior, exact line or token recognition, whitespace and escaping, delimiter-like text inside managed payload, line versus block comments, and append separator and newline convention. Canon already requires ambiguous bounds to fail without mutation.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects exact start/end grammar, section identity and escaping, supported format registry, matching and payload rules, unknown-format behavior and append convention; unmatched, reversed, duplicate, interleaved, nested and payload-like cases are unambiguous; managed-content Canon records the active syntax and the partial engine can proceed without guessing.

title: Define verification-command execution contract
description:
Owner decision required for repository-declared check process mechanics. Define argv versus shell representation, absent policy, absent or empty command list, duplicate commands, configured order and snapshot, stop-versus-continue after one failure, working directory, environment, stdin, timeout and cancellation, process-tree termination, capture-channel mechanics, and exit, signal, spawn and timeout classification. Side effects and evidence limits are separate.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines no-check and duplicate behavior with no implicit default commands, list snapshot and failure continuation, complete process finality with no ambient shell assumptions, child/descendant handling, capture channels and every terminal classification; evidence size/redaction/retention remain owned by the evidence decision; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract.

title: Define scoped Git mutation and push contract
description: Owner decision required before Omnirepo may construct a commit or push it. Define commit granularity for clean synchronization, repair, and explicit migration; message, author, committer, signing, hooks and empty-commit behavior; pre-existing index/worktree/local commits; non-Git, detached, unborn, ahead, behind and diverged states; exact remote/ref/upstream and credentials. Force publication is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines local commit and remote push contracts that cannot stage, publish or rewrite unrelated work or pre-existing commits; exact OID/ref reconciliation covers local commit, remote acceptance, timeout and restart ambiguity; no configured Git mechanism may widen effects into deployment or other authority roots; fleet-lifecycle Canon records it; fixtures cover every selected state.

title: Define durable run-record identity, schema, and invocation boundary
description: Owner decision required for the timestamped run record. Define when a CLI invocation becomes a fleet run, which read-only argument and machine-authority discovery may precede record creation, how pre-record failures are represented, canonical run and repository identities, collision-free path mapping, versioned states, checkpoint ordering, truncated-tail validity, and record creation, writer, and finalization failure outcomes. Operational admission and resume are owned by the interruption contract.
acceptance_criteria: The owner supplies an invocation-to-run and failure matrix, record/path/repository identity, schema/version, allowed transitions, checkpoint durability and tail recovery, unique timestamp collision behavior, and create/write/finalize outcomes before and after external effects. CLI, repair and migration use the same identities; no false record reference is emitted; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract.

title: Define repair eligibility and durable attempt accounting
description: Owner decision required for proving sync-induced repair eligibility and bounding attempts. Define the pre-effect baseline, uncertainty, durable reservation and incomplete-attempt consumption, fallback and restart, frozen inputs, and failed-attempt residue. Supply an exhaustive stage eligibility table for machine/source preflight, repository policy, plan, write, verification, journal, local commit, push, cancellation, and crash. Unrelated or uncertain causation always aborts.
acceptance_criteria: Only owner-approved synchronization or verification failures with proved current-run causation can reach an agent; shared authority, journal, Git delivery, cancellation and crash do not silently become repairable. The owner defines first-run evidence, budget precedence and scope, crash/fallback accounting and immutable preconditions; fleet-lifecycle Canon records it; agent assertions never establish causation.

title: Define declared migration artifact, release binding, and lifecycle contract
description:
Owner decision required for mandatory breaking guidance and optional automated migration. Define release-bound guidance; explicitly choose whether a machine artifact and migrator exist; if selected, define declaration schema, integrity, from/to versions, predecessor range, skipped-release composition, delegation, idempotence, failure residue, cleanup and safe re-entry. Destination selection remains within the machine-declared fleet.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Every breaking release has actionable guidance; automation is explicitly selected or declined and never inferred; no install, config load or sync implicitly migrates; a selected artifact has complete applicability, integrity, idempotence, rollback-or-retain, cleanup, interruption and recovery behavior; protected machine/source authority and unrelated maintenance remain unavailable; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract.

title: Define fleet CLI and process outcome contract
description: Owner decision required for the public machine-driven surface. Define common sync and diagnostic command conventions, permitted overrides, every process status including record-unavailable and cancellation, stdout/stderr, TTY/non-TTY, prompts and noninteractive behavior, optional machine format, signals, config-independent help/version, and the concise failure projection. Setup and optional migration own their specific effects.
acceptance_criteria: Every invocation has one status and stream contract; every determinable selected repository including cancelled or not-started has a durable terminal state when the record is available; record creation failure has an explicit diagnostic without a false pointer; noninteractive sync is prompt-free; help/version/parse errors have no config, record or repository effects; any machine mode is the same public surface; unselected JSON, dry-run or preview is not invented; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract.

title: Implement repository-declared verification executor
description:
Implement the internal verifier used only by synchronization and permitted recovery. Execute repository-owned checks under decided process and side-effect contracts, capture typed bounded evidence, terminate complete process trees, protect authority roots outside prompts, and classify every repository delta against the frozen authorized-delta manifest. This is not a public arbitrary runner.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Checks run in configured order and scope; spawn, nonzero, signal, timeout, forbidden effect and success are typed. Verification may leave only owner-classified ephemeral check artifacts: no tracked or semantic change outside the frozen synchronization delta survives or enters Git, and inability to confine or restore it fails verification. Managed parity, authority, plan, snapshot and delta are revalidated immediately after checks; hangs cannot suppress peers or journaling.

title: Push the recorded operation commit and reconcile remote ambiguity
description:
Publish only the exact operation-scoped commit already constructed and durably recorded by the local commit bead. Use the owner-selected remote and ref under sanitized Git transport, prohibit force and incidental ref publication, and reconcile accepted-but-disconnected, timeout, crash, retry, and remote movement ambiguity.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Only the recorded OID and ref are offered; no pre-existing or newer local commit, tag, branch, or unrelated ref is published; repository Git config, includes, hooks, filters, credential or remote helpers, sshCommand, pushurl/refspec and environment cannot widen effects; inability to confine fails before remote contact; retry and restart query durable local and remote evidence and never duplicate or rewrite publication.

title: Implement canonical machine configuration authority
description:
Replace legacy global configuration with the canonical machine authority only. It owns the declared fleet, ordered authoritative sources, and machine-owned controls selected by the owner contracts. Snapshot it before effects, reject alternate authority and aliases, and emit contextual redacted errors. Destination policy and source declaration parsing are separate consumers.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Only the canonical location and owner-selected extensions load; the schema owns fleet and ordered sources but never destination applicability or repository commands; clean HOME, malformed, unknown, duplicate, conflicting, unsupported-version, cross-role and alias cases fail before source or destination effects; legacy .omni.yaml and arbitrary --config authority follow explicit migration or error policy; round-trip and invalid fixtures pass.

title: Implement trusted configured agent adapter with fail-closed confinement
description:
Implement deterministic configured agent discovery and structured invocation shared by repair and explicitly delegated migration. Enforce protected roots, data exposure, credentials, environment, process tree, control protocol, resource limits and evidence outside prompts before contact; do not grant agents Git delivery, source, fleet, config or run-record authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Only compatible configured tools selected under the trusted-discovery contract run; invocation has no ambient shell ambiguity; forbidden capability or unprovidable confinement fails before contact; independent snapshots and manifests reject forbidden, concurrent, late or forged deltas before lifecycle continuation; prompt injection, hostile repositories, crash, timeout, descendants, oversized output and cross-repository attempts pass adversarial tests.

title: Wire final fleet CLI, bounded repair, and run finalization
description:
Wire the constitutional public fleet command around the canonical initial fleet-pass application service. Establish the durable run at the owner-decided invocation boundary before source acquisition, cache writes, leases, destination or Git effects; run the initial pass; invoke bounded post-pass repair for eligible failures; fold terminal outcomes; finalize the record and concise projection.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: No arbitrary source, config or fleet override exists; missing or invalid machine authority never triggers ambient scanning; source unavailability follows its policy without dropping precedence; invalid repository policy fails that destination while peers continue; changed, unchanged, empty, partial, total, cancelled, recovered, repair, record-create, record-write and finalization cases match the CLI contract; help and version remain side-effect-free; legacy verbose/logger/progress behavior is absent unless explicitly selected.

title: Add final constitutional acceptance suite
description:
Add an epic-level black-box suite proving the completed constitutional product across CLI, configuration authority, source precedence, exact whole and partial synchronization, containment, transactions, independent outcomes, verification, Git, records, crash recovery, bounded repair, agent confinement, setup and owner-selected supported platforms. Release qualification and optional testing methods remain in their owning tracks.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A checked-in traceability matrix maps every constitutional boundary, every never-at-the-cost-of limit and every positive product obligation to named positive and negative black-box tests. The suite rejects all legacy authority/orchestration and containment/verification/repair violations, covers setup, quiet and record-unavailable output, overlap, crash/restart and hostile agents, runs on owner-selected MSRV platforms, and invents no numeric target, release guarantee, JSON mode, preview, or optional migration.

title: Make version and release provenance deterministic and gate publication
description:
Replace the quarantined main-push bump and release race with one owner-decided tag-to-source flow. Bind tag, exact commit, Cargo and binary version, changelog, migration declaration and release name; validate conventional and breaking inputs; run every Canon gate on that exact commit; stage all artifacts before public publication; and repair cog.toml metadata and authority.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Untagged main pushes cannot publish; equivalent conflicting tags are rejected; all required gates run on one exact SHA; staged artifacts come only from that gated workflow and carry verified digests/version identity across jobs; untrusted PR/fork input or output cannot reach write-token publication; actions are immutable; tag, package, binaries, changelog, guidance and migration identity are reverified before non-draft publication; reruns are idempotent and serialized.

title: Unify local and CI coverage gate execution
description:
Coverage thresholds are enforced in CI, but local documented piping and duplicated report commands can mask the cargo llvm-cov exit status or present stale evidence. Provide one authoritative local and CI entry point that preserves the threshold result and report artifacts.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: One repository-owned coverage command enforces 95 percent lines, 80 percent functions, and 80 percent regions with locked all-target all-feature settings; local and CI call the same gate; report generation cannot replace or mask the threshold exit status; documentation and tests or workflow validation are updated.

title: Define supported platforms, filesystem identity, and path representation
description: Owner decision required for the supported operating-system and filesystem classes, public path representation, and fail-closed behavior on unsupported platforms. Engineering in the containment bead owns platform-specific canonicalization, alias, case, Unicode, separator, prefix, UNC/device, non-Unicode, link, junction, reparse, mount, hard-link and non-regular-file mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: The owner names supported platform and filesystem classes, the public configuration path representation, and unsupported-platform behavior. The smallest owning Canon page records that durable support contract. Engineering derives one consistent collision and containment identity across config, source, destination, Git, process and run-record code and proves the platform mechanisms without asking the owner to design algorithms.

title: Define managed-file replacement durability and metadata contract
description:
Owner decision required for replacement behavior beyond textual authority. Decide atomic visibility under interruption or crash, temporary-file placement and cleanup, durability and fsync expectations, parent-directory residue, and preservation, replacement, or rejection behavior for permissions, ownership, ACLs, extended attributes, timestamps, read-only files, hard links, and special files.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects complete failure, interruption, durability, cleanup, and metadata behavior for new, changed, and unchanged managed files; managed-content Canon records the guarantee; whole-file and partial-section implementations can share one replacement primitive without inventing filesystem policy.

title: Implement containment-aware atomic managed-file transactions
description:
Implement the common destination-file transaction used by whole-file and partial-section synchronization. Resolve all planned changes to one file, verify containment and file identity, compare exact authoritative content, and publish through the decided durability and metadata contract without exposing truncation or following an unsafe alias.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A named, decision-derived fault matrix covers each write, flush, sync, metadata, replace, cleanup and crash boundary; every row asserts old-or-complete-new content, decided metadata, residue and typed outcome; unchanged content performs no replacement; multiple sections apply once without outside-content changes; intervening edits, aliases, hard links, special files, permissions and ENOSPC never mutate outside authority.

title: Define interruption, recovery, and overlapping-run contract
description:
Owner decision required for process overlap and death using the run identities/states defined by the record contract. Define admission and lease scope, ordering and wait-or-fail behavior, stale-owner proof and PID reuse, signals and cancellation, queued and in-flight classification, resume versus terminalize-and-rerun, frozen source/plan/check/HEAD validation, typed-stage recovery, and whether explicit repair or migration delegation survives restart. Git ambiguity is owned by the Git contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines every overlap, interruption, restart, stale-lease, cancellation, ambiguous-effect, and final-outcome case while preserving independent progress for disjoint repositories; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the durable contract; coordination and recovery can be implemented without guessing resume, retry, or lock semantics.

title: Implement crash-recoverable run coordination and repository leases
description:
Implement durable run admission, per-repository exclusion, monotonic lifecycle checkpoints, cancellation, stale-owner recovery, and restart reconciliation under the decided contract. Disjoint repositories remain concurrent while one canonical destination can never undergo overlapping sync, verification, agent, or Git mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Durable intent precedes first mutation; interruption may leave only schema-valid recoverable in-flight states and recovery produces exactly one terminal state per selected repository; kill points at every lifecycle boundary, two processes, stale PID reuse, corrupt tails, ambiguous typed Git state, orphan children and restart reconcile without duplicate commit, push, or agent attempts.

title: Load source-repository declarations with deterministic precedence
description:
Materialize ordered source snapshots, load their owner-decided declarations, validate and extract authoritative content, and build one immutable provenance catalog. Invalid machine authority is global. A source acquisition or declaration failure becomes a typed unavailable catalog state; it is never silently removed, reordered, or replaced by lower priority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Every catalog entry carries source identity, pinned revision, declaration identity, extraction provenance and exact content. Duplicate and overlap resolution follows declared order and owner policy. Only repositories whose complete authoritative plan cannot be proven fail for an unavailable source; provably independent peers remain eligible. Concurrent source mutation, reversed authority, and malformed declarations fail contextually without promoting a lower source.

title: Define source declaration and authoritative content extraction schema
description: Owner decision required for the records authoritative source repositories expose. Inherit identity, duplicate and selector semantics from the managed-item decision; define declaration fields, whole-file versus section mode, content locator and relative base, bounded-source versus separate-snippet extraction, source-to-destination mapping, section reference, applicability metadata, missing/non-regular content, provenance and validation.
acceptance_criteria: The owner supplies a complete machine-readable declaration and extraction contract for whole files and sections that preserves exact content, makes authority edges visible, confines source reads, and uses the already-decided item identity/collision rules; configuration-authority and managed-content Canon record it; fixtures express every valid and invalid item without inferred fields.

title: Define configuration schema evolution and compatibility contract
description:
Owner decision required for evolving machine, source, and repository configuration. Decide schema version representation; absent, old, future, and mixed versions; compatibility window; unknown and deprecated fields; semantic reinterpretation prohibition; break detection; and the relationship between unsupported configuration and actionable or automated migration.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported and unsupported version combination has deterministic load, error and explicit migration behavior; merely loading old, unsupported or future config never mutates files or implicitly delegates migration; no version silently changes fleet, source, precedence, applicability, command or delimiter meaning; configuration-authority Canon records the contract.

title: Implement policy-driven immutable source materialization
description:
Implement acquisition, refresh, pinning, caching, and immutable per-run snapshots for machine-declared source repositories under the decided source policy. Isolate staging from destination work, coordinate concurrent materializers, publish only complete snapshots, and expose the exact revision and provenance consumed by catalog loading.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Each run consumes one complete pinned snapshot per ordered source; unavailable or invalid higher sources are never dropped; cache/offline/dirty/interrupted/auth/network cases follow policy; isolated staging and sanitized Git/network execution prevent source-controlled hooks, filters, helpers, alternates, submodule/LFS or executable protocols from escaping, reaching destinations or leaking credentials; provenance is immutable for the run.

title: Implement phased configuration preflight and actionable diagnostics
description:
Validate machine authority before destination effects, then carry typed source availability into per-repository planning and validate explicit repository policy independently. Invalid machine configuration is global; source failure scope follows its owner policy and never drops, reorders, or promotes authority. Produce aggregated, stable, redacted diagnostics identifying tier, path, field, source, repository, item, and remediation.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed, unknown, duplicate, conflicting, missing, unreadable, non-regular, multi-format, unsupported-version and alias cases are covered; only true policy absence may infer. A repository proceeds only when its complete authoritative plan can be proven, while provably source-independent and policy-valid peers continue. Config or source failures never promote lower priority. Seeded secrets appear in neither projection nor record.

title: Define trusted agent discovery and invocation protocol
description:
Owner decision required for discovering and invoking configured repair and migration agents. Define the lawful configuration tier and precedence for agent priority, adapter identity/options and harness selection; per-repository applicability; absent, empty, incompatible and exhausted lists; permitted CLI override; executable identity and replacement-race handling; capability/version checks; structured argv/stdin/control framing; noninteractive finality and evidence identity.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines deterministic configured tool selection, executable identity, capability and protocol authentication/framing, replacement races, fallback and every unavailable/incompatible outcome; the adapter distinguishes control from untrusted output and rejects self-asserted success; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the durable contract.

title: Define agent trust, data exposure, credential, and environment policy
description: Owner decision required for the pre-execution trust boundary around local or remote coding agents. Treat repository files and instructions, filenames, diffs, checks, migration content, and agent output as untrusted data. Decide what repository/context data may be disclosed; environment, credential, SSH/helper/proxy inheritance; network and process capabilities; protected roots; late writes; and behavior when confinement cannot be provided. Adapter framing belongs to agent invocation and post-execution evidence storage/redaction belongs to the evidence contract.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines permitted pre-execution disclosure, credentials/environment, network/process capabilities, protected authorities and fail-closed unavailable-confinement behavior; no rule grants secrets or general orchestration; invocation and evidence owners consume rather than duplicate it; all agent consumers share the contract; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the durable trust boundary.

title: Add adversarial agent and hostile-repository acceptance matrix
description:
Build black-box adversarial fixtures for the shared agent boundary and repository-controlled data. Exercise hostile AGENTS and CLAUDE text, source declarations, migration content, filenames, diffs, verification output, fake control messages, fake success, credential probing, descendants, post-exit writes, hooks, filters, Git config, URL rewrites, concurrent edits, incompatible agents, crash, timeout, and oversized output.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The matrix covers hostile instructions, declarations, filenames, diffs, checks and fake control/success; YAML alias/depth/size exhaustion; Git config/includes/helpers; record-path symlink/race; verifier managed-byte drift; credential exfiltration; post-success late writes; release artifact/control substitution; no content can gain authority, escape scope, forge evidence, access forbidden credentials, publish, weaken checks or mutate after finality; peers finish and failures remain attributable.

title: Implement bounded fleet and child-work scheduler
description:
Implement bounded admission for repositories and nested verification or agent child work under the engineered concurrency controls. Preserve unspecified completion order, sequential per-repository stages, cancellation and full fleet outcome accounting. Durable journal delivery and evidence bounds are owned by their dedicated components.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Observed active-repository, child-process and queue high-water marks stay within configured limits plus documented fixed overhead; unaffected peers finish within finite deterministic scheduler steps despite bounded failures or hangs; cancellation classifies queued and active items; tests prove no oversubscription, deadlock, starvation, lost admission or outcome-order dependence.

title: Test supported filesystem platforms on the MSRV
description:
Add a CI matrix and platform-real fixtures for every owner-supported filesystem platform on Rust 1.86. Exercise the selected identity, containment, replacement, metadata, process termination, Git representation, run-record, and lease contracts instead of assuming Linux pathname and signal behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Each supported platform runs complete MSRV tests and documentation tests plus capability-gated filesystem cases for case and Unicode aliases, non-Unicode names where representable, links, junctions or reparse points, mounts, hard links, non-regular files, permissions, metadata, atomic replacement, concurrent leases, and child termination; unsupported behavior fails explicitly.

title: Add large-fleet performance and exhaustion regression suite
description:
Create deterministic 100- to 500-repository correctness and diagnostic benchmark scenarios over the integrated lifecycle. Measure planning, source reuse, bounded work, verification, journaling, cancellation and mixed failure without turning timing or throughput into a gate until an owner supplies a stable budget.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: One source materialization and catalog serves a run; authoritative content is stored or spooled once rather than copied per destination; peak heavyweight state scales with configured active work; all selected resource and evidence bounds hold; randomized completion preserves the same outcome set; typed exhaustion never truncates authority or loses accounting; timing remains informational.

title: Build per-repository synchronization plans with explicit scope and inference
description:
For each machine-declared destination, snapshot explicit repository policy or apply owner-decided inference only when policy is truly absent. Resolve applicable source items, all/allow/exclude reasons, precedence and every whole/section collision into a typed plan grouped by destination file before mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Absent policy infers exactly under the applicability truth table; commands-only, omitted selector, empty selector, allow, exclude, unknown IDs and zero items follow decided semantics; present invalid, unreadable, disappearing or replaced policy fails that repository and never infers; collisions and reserved targets resolve before writes; identical ordered inputs serialize byte-identical plans regardless of filesystem enumeration or worker completion, while changing declared source order changes only the contract-selected conflict winners.

title: Refactor remaining ambient effects behind injected adapters
description:
Optional late engineering cleanup after the constitutional fleet CLI exists. Remove remaining GLOBAL_CONFIG and direct ambient HOME, PATH, network, Git, clock, terminal or global Rayon access from code that does not own those effects, and prove isolated run contexts do not leak state. This bead changes no public behavior or durable guarantee.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Two isolated run contexts execute concurrently without configuration, adapter, clock, output or scheduler leakage; remaining ambient effects are confined to their owning adapters; domain behavior stays covered by existing component and black-box tests; Canon impact is none.

title: Remove the legacy ad hoc synchronization source surface
description:
Boundary 2 requires one-way machine-declared source authority. Remove the public legacy sync inputs that accept arbitrary URLs, template IDs, local source files, destination roots, or direct target authority, together with the old reqwest/template resolution path, tests, and documentation. This removal does not implement the replacement fleet command.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Public help and APIs cannot promote an arbitrary URL, local file, template, or destination repository to authoritative source content; legacy source-selection and central-dir synchronization code, tests, and docs are removed; no hidden compatibility path reverses authority; Canon quality gates pass.

title: Quarantine unsafe main-push tagging and publication
description:
Disable every current independent main-push bump and publication path, including external reusable workflow authority and cog.toml post-bump push/tag hooks, until canonical release policy and deterministic qualification exist. Inventory the conflicting existing 0.8.3, v0.8.3 and vrefs/heads/main tags/releases without choosing, moving, deleting or repointing them.

## Steps to Reproduce

Push to main under the current workflows and observe that tag and release jobs can publish independently of a uniquely bound release commit.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A normal main push cannot create or move a tag, create a public release, or upload binaries; no mutable external reusable workflow retains tag or release authority; equivalent version tags pointing to different commits are detected and reported without history rewrite; static workflow validation proves untagged commits cannot publish.

title: Define release identity, breaking-change signaling, and distribution contract
description: Owner decision required for lawful breaking releases. Define canonical version source and tag, release trigger, exact source binding, equivalent tags, pre-1.0 breaking signaling, supported channels and targets, package surface linkage, partial multi-channel publication finality, retry and reconciliation, and binding among release identity, migration declaration and guidance.
acceptance_criteria: One canonical mapping exists among commit, package version, tag, binary version, changelog, release and migration identity; supported baselines are identified by actual artifact, source commit, reported version and schema; every partial-publication state has a non-destructive visibility, retry and reconciliation outcome; channels/platforms and conflicting-tag handling are named; immutable publication is never rolled back or repointed; Canon records the Principle 8 guarantee.

title: Build provenance-bound non-public release candidate bundles
description:
Build and qualify staged, non-public artifacts for every owner-selected distribution channel, binding package and binary contents to one exact release identity. Candidate construction is separate from public publication and from optional destination-repository migration.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Clean-tree locked package and bundles contain only owner-approved package files; cargo package --list is checked against the selected allow or deny contract; the packaged crate, not only the worktree, builds, tests and documents on the selected MSRV targets; binaries and archives report canonical identity and carry verified digest, version and SHA provenance; every supported channel installs fresh; unsupported or mismatched artifacts fail before publication.

title: Define repository synchronization transaction and failure residue
description: Owner decision required for destination repository residue across multi-file or multi-section synchronization and later lifecycle stages. Shared machine/source versus per-repository preflight scope is already governed elsewhere, and per-file temporary/metadata behavior belongs to the replacement contract. Decide multi-item ordering and grouping, continuation after one item fails, rollback versus retained authoritative changes, and visible worktree/index residue after synchronization, verification, repair, migration, local commit, or push failure.
acceptance_criteria: The owner supplies one exhaustive stage-by-stage residue table for multi-item application and lifecycle effects, including forbidden, partial, concurrent and late repair or migration deltas. It never redecides shared authority scope or per-file durability. Managed-content and fleet-lifecycle Canon record the behavior; all consumers and recovery tests can assert one unambiguous worktree and index state.

title: Define verification side effects and confinement contract
description: Owner decision required for repository-declared verification confinement. Checks may read the destination and produce explicitly classified ephemeral artifacts, but Boundary 4 makes semantic destination mutation exclusive to synchronization and separately delegated repair or migration. Decide environment, network, process, ephemeral artifact cleanup, and fail-closed protection of source, machine config, record, Git authority and peers.
acceptance_criteria: No owner option permits a verification command to leave tracked or semantic changes outside the frozen synchronization delta or to broaden the authorized Git delta. Managed bytes/sections, policy, source authority, machine config, journal and other repositories remain protected; inability to confine or restore ephemeral artifacts fails verification; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the exact allowed effects and enforcement occurs outside command text.

title: Define repository applicability and inference semantics
description: Owner decision required only for the explicit repository-policy selection schema and truth table. The Constitution and active Canon already fix the outer cases: a truly absent policy infers all applicable source-declared items; any present policy is intentional and disables inference. Define commands-only, omitted selector, intentionally empty, all, allow and exclude combinations, matching, unknown selectors, target-existence relevance and zero-item behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The owner supplies an exhaustive explicit-policy selection truth table with explainable include and exclude reasons. True absence and every present state are distinct; present empty or commands-only policy never infers; config and planner tests cover every branch; configuration-authority Canon records the active rule without asking the owner to redecide it.

title: Define run-evidence security, bounds, and retention policy
description:
Owner decision required for evidence stored in run records. Define evidence classes, encoding/binary behavior, redaction, permissions, retention/deletion and terminal exposure; where configurable limits live, precedence, per-stream and per-item bounds, and truncation markers. Evidence bounds must preserve final outcome accounting.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines evidence classes, limit authority/precedence, encoding/binary handling, truncation, redaction, permissions, retention/deletion and terminal exposure; control, ANSI/OSC, newline and record-structure injection are rendered inert; redaction is tested after truncation and across chunk boundaries while bounded raw evidence follows policy; no hostile output can lose final outcome accounting.

title: Implement synchronization-specific setup and first-sync onboarding
description:
Implement a narrow onboarding path to canonical machine configuration, source declaration validation, destination and repository-policy diagnostics, and first inferred synchronization. It may prepare synchronization authority explicitly selected by the user but must not create arbitrary repositories or discover an ambient fleet.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: From clean HOME and each existing-target state selected by the setup contract, the public surface validates or writes only explicit canonical synchronization authority, is idempotent, leaves no ambiguous partial authority, explains inference and errors, and reaches first sync through the normal fleet command; humans and agent subprocesses use the same prompt-free mode; no ambient scan, repository generator or general runner exists.

title: Implement idempotent exact whole-file synchronization
description:
Apply whole-file plan entries through the shared contained file transaction. Compare the owner-decided exact representation and replace authoritative content only when different; preserve exact newline, Unicode, BOM and invalid-sequence behavior selected by policy; aggregate repository-local errors while peers continue.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative exact content creates missing and replaces drifting whole files; an equal target is a true filesystem no-op on every supported platform; LF, CRLF, mixed, final-newline, Unicode, BOM and invalid-sequence cases follow the encoding contract; nested paths and missing targets work; source decode/acquisition failure writes nothing; replacement, metadata, residue and concurrent-edit behavior come from the shared transaction; repeated runs are idempotent.

title: Define managed-content, catalog, cache, and exhaustion limits
description: Optional hardening decision for hostile or exceptionally large non-evidence inputs and storage. If pursued, define config, catalog, managed-content, snapshot/cache/staging and temporary resource limits, memory versus spooling, eviction, exhaustion outcomes and cleanup. It must not become a prerequisite for constitutional synchronization; ordinary operating-system resource failures remain typed and accounted without owner-selected numeric budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Every resource class has an owner-selected limit or explicit unbounded treatment, configuration authority and precedence, exhaustion outcome, cleanup behavior, and durable diagnostic; in-use snapshots cannot be evicted; exact content is never truncated or normalized; a higher-priority source is never omitted under pressure; peer progress and complete accounting follow the selected failure scope.

title: Define synchronization setup and configuration-authoring contract
description:
Owner decision required for synchronization-specific setup. Decide whether the public setup surface validates, creates, or updates each canonical machine config, source declaration, and destination policy; required explicit inputs and authority confirmation; clean-HOME and existing valid, invalid, or conflicting targets; idempotence; atomicity, permissions, and failure residue; source refresh/cache and run-record effects; and interactive versus noninteractive behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A complete state-and-effect truth table writes only explicitly selected canonical synchronization authority; repeated setup is a no-op; failure never leaves ambiguous fleet or source authority; ambient fleet discovery, arbitrary repository creation, and general orchestration are unavailable; the same public prompt-free mode is usable by humans and agents; the smallest owning Canon page records durable setup behavior.

title: Add model-based lifecycle recovery and fault-injection suite
description:
Optional hardening suite using generated, shrinkable state-machine tests for lifecycle, journal, lease, Git, repair, migration, cancellation and restart. Required deterministic fault cases remain in their owning implementation and acceptance beads; this method is not itself a constitutional product guarantee.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Generated action sequences and shrunk regressions prove exactly one final outcome per selected repository after recovery, no duplicate commit, push, repair or migration attempt, no unrecorded external effect, no effect outside authority, and independent completion of disjoint repositories; fixed-seed replay is deterministic and tests contain no wall-clock sleeps.

title: Make required quality gates repository-owned and reproducible
description:
Replace mutable or duplicated required-check control with repository-owned entry points used identically by local and CI. Cover every normative Canon gate, including the Beads decision validator and pre-commit, without external mutable workflow code or shell pipelines masking a sub-gate failure.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run the workflow described above and observe the mismatch.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Repository-owned commands execute exact format, warning-denying Clippy, locked all-target/all-feature tests, documentation tests, build, pre-commit including .beads/validate-decisions.sh, coverage thresholds and Rust 1.86 checks; local and CI call the same entry points; Cargo.lock remains tracked and is not ignored, and package lock behavior follows the package contract; workflow tests reject omitted flags, altered thresholds, masked exits and mutable external control.

title: Implement durable run journal and recovery substrate
description:
Implement the persistence substrate separate from final presentation. At the owner-decided invocation boundary, create the canonical run record before source acquisition, cache mutation, lease, destination, process, agent or Git effects; accept versioned events from concurrent producers, acknowledge checkpoints, and provide crash-safe replay plus typed persistence failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Collision-safe creation records intent before external effects; failures before fleet or repository identity follow the pre-record matrix; one bounded writer preserves monotonic order; writer backpressure or failure follows policy and halts new effects when required; interrupted and truncated tails replay valid states; post-commit or post-push recovery preserves evidence; every persistence fault is deterministically injectable and no final success is claimed without proof.

title: Define Cargo package contents and public Rust API contract
description: The owner must decide whether Omnirepo is a binary-only product or supports a public Rust library, the exact supported API and semantic-versioning treatment, documentation and doctest obligations, and the governance or development assets intentionally included in the Cargo package. Current omnirepo_lib exports legacy general-orchestration surfaces, so removal or compatibility cannot be guessed. Record the active contract on the smallest routed Canon page.
acceptance_criteria: One owner-approved package and API contract identifies every supported executable and Rust surface, states how removals receive actionable migration guidance, and defines an explicit package allow or deny policy. No forbidden legacy authority remains accidentally public, and no implementation chooses binary-only versus library support on its own.

title: Retire legacy shared crate surface and dependency residue
description:
After the forbidden command surfaces and canonical configuration replacement land, remove shared legacy exports, types, helpers, tests, dependencies, and features that would otherwise preserve tag, template, .omni, ad hoc source, or general runner authority through omnirepo_lib or internal modules.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib.rs exposes only the owner-selected API; legacy Config, RepoConfig, GLOBAL_CONFIG, tag and template helpers and obsolete tests are absent unless used by the lawful replacement; every direct dependency and feature has a production or test consumer; Cargo.lock changes are deterministic; the crate builds, tests, documents, and packages under the selected contract.

title: Implement canonical repository-state snapshots and authorized-delta manifests
description:
Create the immutable handoff shared by planning, verification, repair causation, Git delivery, journaling, and recovery. Capture repository identity, HEAD and ref state, index and worktree facts, frozen authority identities, and the exact operation-authorized delta without running repository-controlled hooks, filters, helpers, or diff drivers.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The snapshot distinguishes pre-existing state from current-operation additions, deletions, renames, type, mode, link, non-Unicode, and concurrent changes; the manifest binds canonical repository, source, catalog, configuration, plan, base HEAD, and authorized paths or managed sections; consumers can revalidate it without inferring authority or causation; hostile repository mechanisms cannot widen or falsify it; deterministic fixtures cover dirty index and worktree combinations.

title: Implement one-repository initial synchronization pass
description:
Build the smallest complete destination-repository slice. Given a frozen plan, journal sink, canonical repository snapshot, and authorized-delta manifest, execute contained managed-content replacement, configured verification, and scoped Git delivery, then return a typed initial-pass result.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Changed, unchanged, failed, and cancelled paths are deterministic and replayable; unchanged input performs no write or Git mutation; every injected stage failure has the policy-selected residue and one initial-pass result; all handoffs preserve the canonical repository, authority, plan, HEAD, and delta identities. Fleet scheduling, repair, migration, CLI rendering, and final run projection are absent.

title: Compose the canonical initial fleet-pass application service
description:
Compose machine authority, source availability, repository policy, planning, durable admission and leases, and fleet fan-out into one internal initial-pass application service. It is the only bridge from canonical configuration to initial repository execution.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The service snapshots lawful inputs, performs policy-scoped preflight, attempts every repository whose complete authoritative plan can be proven, and returns typed initial results plus frozen repair inputs. It invokes no agent, does not finalize a run, renders nothing, and exposes no second public authority path.

title: Implement managed partial sections and delimiter knowledge
description:
Implement the owner-selected comment-syntax registry and managed-section editor on top of the shared contained file transaction. Match literal start and end delimiters and section identity, preserve all content outside every managed span exactly, group multiple sections in one file, append a missing declared section under the decided separator convention, and reject every ambiguity before mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Existing, empty, adjacent and multiple sections converge and repeat as no-ops; prefix, suffix, other sections, CRLF and final-newline state remain exact; marker-like payload substrings are data; unmatched, reversed, interleaved, nested, duplicate or ambiguous delimiters and unknown formats fail contextually with original bytes unchanged; missing file or pair appends exactly by policy; property tests prove only bounded managed spans change.

title: Construct and record an operation-scoped Git commit
description:
Separate local commit construction from remote publication. Stage only the typed current-operation authorized delta after revalidating the frozen authority, plan, parity, repository snapshot, and base HEAD, and durably record the exact commit identity before any remote contact.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Unrelated index and worktree state remains equivalent; hooks, filters, includes, helpers, attributes, and path aliases cannot widen effects; commit granularity, identity, message, signing, hooks, and empty behavior follow the owner Git contract; crash ambiguity reconciles to one recorded OID and ref; no remote is contacted.

title: Classify repair eligibility and durably reserve an attempt
description:
Turn an initial repository failure into either a terminal failure or one causally bounded repair reservation before any agent contact. Preserve the separately invoked repair boundary and current-run lineage.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: An exhaustive stage table covers preflight, source, policy, plan, write, check, journal, commit, push, cancellation, and crash; only owner-approved synchronization or verification failures with proved current-run causation are eligible; uncertainty reserves no authority; an eligible attempt freezes authority, plan, checks, HEAD, baseline, and budget and is reserved exactly once across restart.

title: Execute and validate one confined repair attempt
description:
Execute exactly one previously reserved repair attempt through the configured agent adapter, external containment, authoritative re-synchronization, frozen verification, and scoped Git delivery.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Forbidden, unrelated, concurrent, or late agent deltas are rejected under the residue policy; source content, fleet membership, source priority, other repositories, and machine authority remain protected; authoritative sync and frozen checks rerun after the attempt; Git delivery occurs only for a valid pass; one typed attempt result is journaled. This bead chooses neither fallback nor exhaustion.

title: Implement destination repository policy loading with explicit absence
description:
Load the one canonical destination repository policy independently from machine fleet and source authority. Return either an immutable valid applicability and verification-command snapshot or a distinct true-absence result.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Unreadable, malformed, replaced, aliased, non-regular, unsupported-version, or cross-role content never becomes absence; a present empty or commands-only policy remains intentional and never triggers inference; the policy cannot define fleet membership, sources, or priority; loading performs no inference, network, process, Git, or destination mutation effect.

title: Enforce symlink-safe containment within the declared fleet
description:
Enforce the constitutional authority roots for every operation using the owner-decided filesystem identity model: source reads within pinned source snapshots; destination file, verification, agent and Git effects within the selected destination; machine configuration and durable records within their roots. Replace lexical-only joining with fail-closed no-follow containment resilient to aliases and concurrent swaps.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Root, intermediate and leaf symlinks plus supported reparse, junction, mount, case, Unicode, separator, hard-link and canonical aliases cannot redirect effects outside authority; relative fields reject absolute, parent and device forms as applicable; config, source, destination, .git and run-record paths are covered; concurrent swap and special-file fixtures fail closed before out-of-root mutation while valid peers finish.

title: Build a hermetic fleet lifecycle integration-test harness
description:
Build reusable schema-neutral hermetic primitives: isolated HOME, PATH, environment, network, credentials and Git configuration; temporary source and destination repositories plus bare remotes; deterministic clock, identifiers, signals and process trees; named filesystem, journal and remote fault points; PTY and non-TTY capture; and two-process barriers. Specialized hostile, platform, scale and constitutional scenarios belong to their owning suites.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Harness self-tests prove deterministic reusable fixtures, fixed-seed replay, explicit barriers and no wall-clock sleeps or ambient services; named APIs cover partial and failed writes, sync/replace failure, run-ID collision, accepted-but-disconnected push, executable replacement, post-exit descendants and intervening worktree edits; every specialized suite can compose these primitives without copying mechanisms.
